name: l2/delete_nodes
description: deleteNodes (incremental/graph_ops.go:54-84), the removal path's delete: `<uid> * * .` per non-empty uid, batch size 2, one worker. The empty uid still occupies a slot in its batch.
comparison: canonical: `writes` is ordered and compared element by element. Each write's `set` and `del` are its N-Quad lines after canonicalisation (parity/README.md §Canonical form): split on newline, blank lines dropped, `<0x..>` rewritten to `<uid:UNIQUE_ID>`, blank nodes rewritten to `_:new:UNIQUE_ID`, sorted bytewise. Line text is otherwise byte-exact, including literal escaping and facet order. Blank-node label strings are NOT compared (P4-3); one label per unique_id per mutation IS required.
